# Music credits

Every track in the music part, where it came from and its licence. Checked 2026-11-17.

All files were shortened (at most 2 min 45 s for band tracks, 4 min for piano, with a fade out), levelled and re-encoded as MP3 (80 kbps stereo; piano 64 kbps mono) for lobby use. The game shows every track's `credit` line (from `config.ts`) under How to play > Music credits.

## Musopen Chopin recordings: public domain (CC0 1.0)

Source item: [The Complete Works of Frédéric Chopin (FLAC)](https://archive.org/details/musopen-chopin-complete-works-flac), uploaded by Musopen, licence [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) on the item. The compositions are public domain too. No credit is legally needed; we give it anyway.
